title: Aromatic Flaky Egyptian Refried Beans Flatbread
description: This pungent and cozy Egyptian dish features refried beans on a flaky flatbread made with long-fermentation dough, perfect for a satisfying lunch.
instructions: Preheat the slate tile in a warm place for 30 minutes before baking.
Roll out the long-fermentation dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Spread the refried beans evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the olive oil over the beans and sprinkle with minced garlic, onion, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Fold the edges of the dough over the beans to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on the preheated slate tile and bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the flatbread warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
